experiment: FlyGraph R55 uncertainty-triggered protected branch reservation
frozen_address_model: R52 optimized binary linear [96,9] ECC, 512 codewords, min distance 41

main.policy: On uncertain hypothesis-steps preserve exact R54 raw+ECC candidate union, mark ECC-only edges as protected, carry protection for a fixed 2 pruning decisions, reserve a calibrated quota of the global 32 beam slots for the highest-scoring live protected descendants, then fill remaining slots by the ordinary global R35 score.

calibration.selection_rule: maximize 2*answer128 + answer64 + 0.5*finalPath128 + 0.25*finalPath64 + answer8; ties prefer smaller quota

ablation: Identical R54 uncertainty trigger, raw+ECC candidate union, top_k=4 and beta=.10, but ordinary global top-32 pruning with no reserved slots.
reference: R52 ECC + frozen R35 baseline rerun on the identical held-out episodes.
success_criterion: R55 vs R54 ablation: 8-hop delta >= -2pp and strict answer improvement at both 64 and 128 hops.
integrity_note: An exploratory pre-final implementation returned reserved candidates before globally sorting the retained beam, which incorrectly made a protected candidate the output. Those exploratory files were deleted. Final calibration and every held-out condition were rerun after fixing this invariant. A separate parallel wrapper also timed out; only the subsequently completed per-seed JSON files listed in metrics are aggregated.
